title: Smooth cutoff with compact support in U equal to 1 on an open neighbourhood of a compact K ⊆ U
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and K ⊆ U compact. Then there are a function ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ and a set N ⊆ ℝ^P such that ζ is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ∞), ζ has compact support, tsupport ζ ⊆ U, 0 ≤ ζ(x) ≤ 1 for every x ∈ ℝ^P, N is open, K ⊆ N, and ζ(x) = 1 for every x ∈ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ ∧ HasCompactSupport ζ ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ U ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) ∧ IsOpen N ∧ K ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ζ x = 1
